{{Quote|Uuk&ndash;tu lok!|The Ewok scout|<ref name="what goes up" />}}
An '''Ewok scout''' lived on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Endor/Legends|moon]] of the [[Gas giant/Legends|gas giant]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Endor (planet)/Legends|Endor]] around [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], the final year of a [[List of battles/Legends|war]] known as the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. When [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|troops]] from the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] arrived on the moon, the [[Ewok/Legends|Ewok's]] clan captured the [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Aayla Secura/Legends|Aayla Secura]], who had arrived with the Republic [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]], and a [[Unidentified B1 battle droid (Endor)|B1 battle droid]] that she had disabled, and brought them both back to the Ewok [[City/Legends|village]]. Secura had arrived to investigate the disappearance of a [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] outpost and a detachment of clone troopers. The Ewoks captured her by knocking her unconscious with a poison dart. When she awoke in the Ewok village, the Ewok scout was the first to greet her, and took an interest in her [[Lekku/Legends|lekku]]. Secura angrily told the Ewok to back off. The [[Unidentified Ewok chief|Ewok chieftain]] explained, through the battle droid's translations, that a [[Beast in the Mouth of the Mountain|monster]] had been terrorizing the village for some time. Believing that Secura was a forest spirit, the Ewoks wanted her to destroy the monster. The Ewok scout along with a few others guided Secura to the monster's cave, which sat far above the forest floor. Directing her to the cave, the Ewoks waited for her return. While Secura was able to [[Death/Legends|kill]] the monster, the battle droid translator had been destroyed during the skirmish.<ref name="what goes up" />
